name: logisx-e2e
//: The browser E2E harness, as its own package: the root install, ci.yml and the deploy never install it, and scripts/run-unit-tests.js never runs it. Its own workflow, .github/workflows/e2e.yml, installs it and runs ci-run.sh on made-up data. Install with `npm --prefix scripts/e2e ci`. See README.md.
